App.metaDescription: Vox Quieta is now on Google Play. Carry daily Bible inspiration, comfort in hard moments, and Scripture-guided conversations wherever you go — private, personal, and ad-free.
App.heroAlt: Vox Quieta — Get inspired daily by God's Word
App.title: Vox Quieta is now on Google Play
App.storyLead: What began as a quiet idea — a companion that meets you in Scripture whenever you need it — is now an app you can hold in your hand.
App.storyBody1: Some days you need encouragement. Some days you carry grief, a question that won't let go, or simply a longing to draw closer to God. Vox Quieta listens, and answers with the living words of Scripture — gently, always pointing you back to the Word.
App.storyBody2: Now it lives on your phone. Open it on the train, in a waiting room, or late at night when sleep won't come, and find a verse, a prayer, and a conversation waiting for you.
App.iosCtaTitle: Add Vox Quieta to your Home Screen
App.iosCtaBody: Tap the Share button in Safari, then choose "Add to Home Screen."
App.feature1Body: A fresh, Bible-rooted word of encouragement every day.
App.feature2Body: Ask what's on your heart and receive answers grounded in God's Word.
App.feature3Body: Available in 11 languages, so Scripture meets you where you are.
App.feature4Body: No ads and no account required — just you and the Word.
App.betaLead: Curious about new features before everyone else?

About.metaDescription: Why Vox Quieta exists, who built it, and what it isn't — a gentle companion for moments of struggle, grounded in Scripture.
About.title: About Vox Quieta
About.heroLead: A place to find hope and inspiration when you need it.
About.whyHook: Have you ever had an idea that just wouldn't leave you alone? Something you felt deeply about but didn't quite have the time or technical bandwidth to build?
About.whyBody1: Depression and mental health struggles affect so many people — young and old alike. I wanted to create something simple, accessible, and deeply rooted in the Bible that could offer encouragement when someone needed it most.
About.whyBody2: Not a replacement for therapy or pastoral care, but a gentle companion for moments of struggle.
About.whyBody3: You are in a bad mood, your work day was terrible, your kids are driving you crazy... I hope you can find some support here grounded in God's Word.
About.notBody: Vox Quieta is not a pastor, not a therapist, and not a substitute for a faith community. It's a gentle companion for moments of struggle — not a replacement for therapy or pastoral care.
About.todayBody: It's grown a lot since that first idea — grounded in Scripture with verse references, in 11 languages, on the web and on Android, free to use. But none of that is really the point. The point is what it's like to open it on a hard day: something steady, waiting, in Scripture, whenever you need it.
About.todayContinuity: When it started, this project was called "Get Inspired by the Bible." It has grown since then, and it's now known as Vox Quieta.
About.builtTitle: Built by one person, with AI help
About.builtBody1: The idea came from me. The understanding of what would be helpful, what tone to strike, what Scripture should guide responses — that required human judgment and care.
About.builtBody2: Technology is just a tool. The "why" behind this project — the empathy for people struggling with mental health, the desire to offer hope — that's entirely human.
About.builtBody3: I'm not a professional frontend developer, and Vox Quieta was built with the help of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AIs. The project is open source.
About.originScreenshotAlt: Screenshot of the original "Get Inspired by the Bible" welcome screen
About.originScreenshotCaption: What it looked like when I first shared this — before the rename to Vox Quieta.
About.fullStoryBody: The origin story — including how it was built — is written up in full.
About.closingBody: But honestly? I'm just happy it exists. It's out there, and someone having a rough day can open this page and find a little encouragement. That's what matters to me.
About.contactBody: What worked? What could be better? What would make it more helpful? I'd like to hear from you.
About.introBody: Depression and mental health struggles affect so many people. Vox Quieta was built to be simple, accessible, and deeply rooted in Scripture — a gentle companion for moments of struggle, not a replacement for therapy or pastoral care.

Tester.metaDescription: Join the Vox Quieta Android closed beta — get early access and help us improve the app.
Tester.title: Become a Beta Tester
Tester.intro: The Vox Quieta Android app is in closed beta. Join our group of testers to get early access and help shape the app with your feedback. It only takes a minute.
Tester.step1Body: Sign in with the Google account you use on the Play Store and join our testers group. This is required to take part in the closed test.
Tester.step2Body: Once you're a member of the group, open the opt-in page and accept to become a tester. It can take a few minutes to activate.
Tester.step3Body: Open Vox Quieta on Google Play and install it like any other app. Updates will arrive automatically.
Tester.note: Testing is completely free and you can leave at any time. Have questions or feedback? Reach us from the home page.
